title: Concierge request harvest & synthesis (april 2026)
summary: Quick harvest of incoming concierge tickets (Mar 20–Apr 8), synthesized into 6 recurring themes and a prioritized short list of product/probe work. Purpose: give PM/Eng a compact, testable set of fixes and experiments we can scope for a 2-week sprint or a spike. This doc is intentionally lightweight — rough asks, customer quotes, immediate probes. Not a final roadmap deliverable.
synthesis_notes: Source mix: inbound concierge emails, support Slack #concierge, two enterprise account calls (FintechCo, HealthFlow), and three self-serve logs. Volume: ~62 unique asks in window; 18 are duplicates/variants and cluster into themes below. Notable pattern: latency/timeout sensitivity spikes for mid‑sized batches, requests for clearer routing/resilience docs, desire for 'model selectors' to prioritize cost vs latency per-route, and recurring embedding drift questions for semantic-search customers. Several asks are low-effort UI/UX clarifications that would reduce ticket volume. Also a handful of security/compliance clarifications for Private deployments.
